title: Internship Project Dolphin Construction Management Support

titleByLocale.it: Supporto alla gestione della costruzione di Dolphin Project Stage
titleByLocale.en: Internship Project Dolphin Construction Management Support
titleByLocale.de: Praktikum Projekt Dolphin Construction Management Unterstützung
titleByLocale.fr: Projet de stage Soutien à la gestion de la construction de Dolphin

descriptionByLocale.it:
We are seeking a motivated Intern (m/f/d) to join our team for our location in Stein. What you’ll get:
• ​A dynamic, agile career path with room to grow
• An inclusive, ethical, and supportive workplace culture
• A comprehensive benefits package tailored to your role and location What you will do:
• Help Construction Management Team to close construction punches
• Support Construction Management Team and Handover Team to close punches.
• Admirative Activities as preparation of punch closure, Handover Folders, Meeting Invites and Signature Requests.
• Verification of Punch closure on site
• On Site verification of Punch closure
• Construction Manager ad hoc support What we are looking for:
• Strong verbal and written communication skills in English
• Eagerness to learn and a positive attitude About Lonza At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of. Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board. Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now. Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.
